claim: Patchline distributes a corpus sweep across many workers through a reproducible work queue so the same task always goes to the same worker, no task is dropped, and no task is processed twice — making a distributed run as auditable as a single-machine one. The worker assigns each task to a worker by a pure hash of the task id, then verifies the partition is complete (the union of all worker queues equals the task set) and disjoint (no task appears in two queues). The gate proves the assignment is deterministic across runs, complete, and non-overlapping, and that an injected duplicate assignment is detected as an overlap.
